Job Description 
  SFDC implementation for last three years and salesforce certified Good understanding of the business requirement and come up with technical design Experience in Sales cloud or Service cloud. 
  Should have working experience in customization using Apex classes, VF pages for various business scenarios. 
  Should have integrated SFDC with other third party applications using Rest/SOAP API 
  Should be able to work individually on the technical deliverables and able to also give demo to stakeholders after sprints if needed 

   9+ years of experience in SalesForce 
 
 Linked Presence with recommendations from previous employers – A MUST 


 Bachelors or Masters

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
